commentary_title: Weak demand plagues Aframax tonne-miles to a new low
commentary_summary: The Aframax tonne-miles Index ended at a new low of 97.4 points in week 34 as the market continues to show no signs of a major upturn. Overall, as the markets remained weak, freight rates followed suit, heading downwards. | There was some movement towards the East but rates declined WoW. To the West, markets in the Mediterranean too remained gloomy with activity likely to weaken further due to political unrest keeping ships from trading in the region. | Due to markets seeming more forward-looking towards the West, there was a slight growth in the tonnage underway. There was also an uptick in the %laden underway vessels which could cushion freight rates from falling further next week.
